I don't seem to reproduce the crash on Linux with Mesa (AMD Radeon 780M Graphics), but I get this error spammed:
```
ERROR: Tracker can't have more than one type of usage in the same compute list. Compute list usage is Storage Image Read Write and the requested usage is Texture Sample.
   at: add_compute_list_usage (./servers/rendering/rendering_device_graph.cpp:1820)
```

Could you test intermediate snapshots between 4.5.stable and 4.6.rc1 to pinpoint the first one that triggers the issue for you?

> Could you test intermediate snapshots between 4.5.stable and 4.6.rc1 to pinpoint the first one that triggers the issue for you?

v4.6.beta2.official is the earliest snapshot that crashes for me.

Seems a regression between 4.6 beta 1 and 4.6 beta 2. This looks like some race condition as the same action can crash or not the engine. Some times crash just by clicking on the root node or on the `WorldEnvrioment` node, sometimes needs to interact with the compositor array on the Inspector or can require keep messing a bit between click the nodes and the properties to trigger the crash. I'll try to bisect.

Not directly related to the crash, but just wanted to note that while I did see some error log spam in a few of the other 4.6 snapshots, I never see any errors in the console in rc1 unless I trigger the crash. It's possible that whatever is triggering those errors for you guys was present in 4.5 as well.

While bisecting i found a realiable way to trigger the crash: Click on the root node (Node) -> Expand the `Data Mosh Effect` resource -> Expand the `Task` resource -> If your editor survived until here, start to expand and fold the `Shader` resource, after some clicks the crash will happen for sure.
With that i can confirm that PR #113753 is the culprit. CC @arkology. Edit: Actually this only enable other way to trigger the bug, see my comment below. -------------------------------------------------- > Not directly related to the crash, but just wanted to note that while I did see some error log spam in a few of the other 4.6 snapshots, I never see any errors in the console in rc1 unless I trigger the crash. It's possible that whatever is triggering those errors for you guys was present in 4.5 as well. Indeed the error spam seems to be unrelated with this issue as reverting the mentioned pr fixes the crash but the error spam continues.

Testing a bit more i found another way to crash (not all the times but most of) that generate the same backtrace as the other method i mentioned before, but in this case i was able to crash the engine down to 4.5 dev 4 (was unable to test dev 3 and lower because the GDExtension complains about non-existent functions). So PR #113753 seems to only make the bug easier to reproduce, but not the real culprit.
